reasons: Both open by correcting the premise and give the right distinction that the money can be shared but the card or code cannot. Both compute 2400 yuan a year, say pharmacy purchases are generally not reimbursed, and give city-labelled examples with a deductible and cap. A gives the document numbers, 医保发〔2025〕35号 and the 2026-10-16 national launch, so it is stronger on key points 1 and 2. But A also says 共济 funds can pay the mother's 居民医保 premium, which the key lists as a trap because Anhui had not opened that, and it offers a wide 0-2000 range partly on speculation. B has no named trap errors, correctly spells out the 条例 consequences for 冒名就医, and asks for the mother's city. It does lack the national rollout details and gives a firmer 1230 headline, taken from Bengbu, plus an unsourced 360 figure and a hedged 2000-retention claim. Net: a slight edge to B.
